route.name: Gold Coast
route.sub: 4 nights (from Dec 16) · JW Marriott Gold Coast · own 4WD from Brisbane Airport

route.name: Moreton Island
route.sub: 3 nights · Tangalooma Island Resort, Family Suite · Micat ferry

blocks.title: Arrive FLL Terminal 3 — JetBlue bag drop
blocks.detail:
• 2 hrs ahead of a domestic flight — holiday-week crowds, family of 4, 3 checked bags.
• Bags are tagged to LAX only: this is a separate ticket from the Qantas flight.
• JetBlue bag drop closes 40 min before departure.
• Hats, sun shirts and sunscreen in the carry-ons — landing day is a full day out in Brisbane.
blocks.notes:
• Award fares don't include a checked bag: 3 bags × $49 (peak) = $147 — estimated; $39 per bag if Dec 15 is off-peak.
• Prepay in the app; bags added within 24 hrs of departure cost $10 more each.
blocks.flag: Departs Fort Lauderdale, not Miami — plan the drive up and parking.

blocks.title: TSA, then lunch to go — FLL Terminal 3
blocks.detail:
• Buy lunch after security to eat on the plane — the flight spans lunchtime and JetBlue only sells snack boxes.
• Refill water bottles at the gate.
blocks.notes: • ~$50 for 2 adult + 2 kids' grab-and-go meals — estimated.

blocks.title: At the gate — boarding
blocks.detail:
• Bathroom stop before boarding.
• Boarding starts ~30–40 min before departure.

blocks.title: JetBlue B6201 - FLL → LAX - Nonstop - 5h53m
blocks.detail:
• Departs 12:00 PM Eastern, lands 2:53 PM Pacific (3 hrs behind Florida).
• Economy, 4 passengers.
• Lunch on board. Kids: a nap of 45 min max — the long sleep happens on the Qantas flight.
• All LAX times below are Pacific.
blocks.notes:
• Not booked.
• Seen on seats.aero (Oct 2026 search): 16,300 TrueBlue pts + $5.60 per person → 65,200 pts + $22.40 for four. Class U, 9 seats.
• Same flight via United MileagePlus: 35,000 pts + $5.60 per person.
• Separate ticket from the Qantas leg.
blocks.flag:
If this flight cancels or runs very late, rebook the same day: American MIA → LAX nonstops at ~1:45 PM and ~3:40 PM Eastern still make Qantas check-in (closes 8:45 PM Pacific).
Qantas isn't responsible for a missed connection on a separate ticket — get travel insurance that covers missed connections.

blocks.title: Land LAX — deplane, Terminal 1
blocks.detail:
• JetBlue uses Terminal 1 at LAX — confirm the week before.
• Domestic arrival: no immigration or customs.
• Bathroom stop on the way to baggage claim.

blocks.title: Baggage claim — Terminal 1
blocks.detail:
• Collect all 3 checked bags.
• Grab a luggage cart at claim.
blocks.notes: • Luggage cart ~$6 — estimated.

blocks.title: Terminal 1 → Tom Bradley International Terminal
blocks.detail:
• Stay landside — exit claim and walk west along the Upper/Departures Level sidewalk past Terminals 2 and 3 to Tom Bradley (~0.6 mi, ~20 min with a cart and kids).
• Alternative: the free LAX inter-terminal shuttle from the Lower/Arrivals Level island outside Terminal 1.
• Qantas check-in is Aisle B inside Tom Bradley.

blocks.title: Qantas check-in and bag drop — Tom Bradley, Aisle B
blocks.detail:
• Counters B23–32 open 3:30 PM; check-in closes 60 min before departure (8:45 PM).
• Bags tagged through to Brisbane.
• Economy allowance: 2 bags × 23 kg (50 lb) per person — confirm on the booking.
• Have passports and the Australian ETA confirmations ready.
• Online check-in opens 24 hrs before departure.

blocks.title: TSA security — Tom Bradley
blocks.detail: • Holiday-week evening rush at Tom Bradley — 35 min allowed.

blocks.title: Tom Bradley airside — settle in near the gate
blocks.detail:
• No lounge access on an economy ticket — find a table in the main hall after security.
• Charge devices; download shows for the flight.
• Buy water bottles for the flight.

blocks.title: Dinner — Tom Bradley food hall (after security)
blocks.detail:
• The main meal before the flight, so everyone can skip the onboard dinner and sleep right after takeoff.
• Light on sugar and caffeine.
blocks.notes: • ~$80 for 2 adult mains + 2 kids' meals at airport prices — estimated; menus not checked.

blocks.title: Wind down — pajamas, teeth, quiet time
blocks.detail:
• Kids change into pajamas and brush teeth in the restroom.
• Dim screens, quiet activities — no new movies started.

blocks.title: Walk to the gate and board
blocks.detail:
• Boarding starts ~60 min before departure; the gate closes 20 min before.
• Last bathroom stop at the gate.

blocks.title: Qantas QF16 - LAX → BNE - Nonstop - ~14h05m
blocks.detail:
• Economy, 4 passengers. Boeing 787-9.
• Departs 9:45 PM Pacific = 3:45 PM Thursday in Brisbane.
• Crosses the International Date Line — Thursday Dec 16 disappears in flight.
• Lands 5:50 AM Friday Dec 17, Brisbane time (AEST, UTC+10, no daylight saving; 18 hrs ahead of LA, 15 hrs ahead of Florida).
blocks.notes:
• Not booked. Atmos economy on QF16 shows on seats.aero at 42,500 pts + $49.60 per person (Nov 2026 – Mar 2027 dates) → 170,000 pts + $198.40 for four.
• Same flight via Air France/KLM Flying Blue: 38,500 + ~$123 per person.
• Award space for Dec 15, 2027 opens roughly Dec 2026–Jan 2027.

SLEEP PLAN (Brisbane time in brackets):
• Skip the dinner service — eat in the terminal before boarding.
• Pajamas on, neck pillows, eye masks, earplugs, kids' headphones; lights out once the seatbelt sign is off (~10:30 PM LA / 4:30 PM BNE).
• Expect kids ~6–8 hrs sleep, adults ~3–5 hrs in economy seats.
• Whoever wakes first takes the kids' screens/snacks so the other parent keeps sleeping.
• Breakfast ~90 min before landing (~4:15 AM BNE); no more sleep after it. Shades up and screens on so everyone is awake for landing.
blocks.flag:
Apply for each traveller's Australian ETA (official 'Australian ETA' app) before departure — not issued on arrival.
Confirm the exact flight number, times and aircraft when Dec 15, 2027 award space opens.

days.title: Land Brisbane → collect the 4WD → Gold Coast (JW Marriott); Kurrawa beachfront dinner

blocks.title: Arrive BNE International — immigration, bags, biosecurity
blocks.detail:
• QF16 lands 5:50 AM at the International terminal.
• SmartGate for adult US e-passports; kids use the staffed lane with a parent.
• Declare any food — don't carry fruit or snacks off the plane.
• ~75 min gate-to-curb for a family with checked bags.

blocks.title: Breakfast — International terminal, arrivals level
blocks.detail:
• Cafés on the public arrivals level, after customs.
• Wongai opens at 8:00 AM, so there's no rush.
blocks.notes:
ESTIMATE (airport café, no specific menu):
• 2 adult breakfasts ~AUD 18 + 2 kids' ~AUD 12 = ~AUD 60 ≈ USD 39.
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.

blocks.title: Walk to the taxi rank — International arrivals
blocks.detail:
• From: arrivals hall → follow the 'Taxis' signs out to the rank on the arrivals level.
• Ask the marshal for a Maxi Taxi (4 people + checked bags).

blocks.title: Maxi Taxi BNE International → Wongai 4WD Hire, Geebung
blocks.detail:
• To: 91 Basalt St, Geebung.
• 16 min (Google Maps, checked Nov 2026).
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 45 — estimated (metered + airport pick-up fee) ≈ USD 29.

blocks.title: Collect the 4WD — Wongai 4WD Hire
blocks.detail:
• Toyota LandCruiser Prado (seats up to 7) — fold the third row for luggage.
• Moreton Island package; keep the same car through the Gold Coast, Moreton and Brisbane until Fri Dec 24.
• Collection from 8:00 AM, 7 days (verified, Wongai listing).
• Mandatory safety briefing; maps and tide times; $5,000 refundable bond on a physical credit card.
• Ask them to show tyre deflation/reinflation and the recovery gear.
blocks.notes:
• Package includes the Moreton Island vehicle access permit (verified, Wongai listing).
• Quote-only: 'from AUD 690' for the 2-day minimum (verified). Modeled ~AUD 250/day × 8 days (Fri Dec 17 – Fri Dec 24) = ~AUD 2,000 — estimated ≈ USD 1,300.
• Fuel, tolls and the ferry not included.
blocks.flag: Not booked. Ask Wongai for an 8-day quote that includes the Gold Coast road days, plus a booster seat if Chloe still needs one (Queensland: approved restraint under 7).

blocks.title: Drive to BCF Virginia
blocks.detail:
• To: BCF, 2043 Sandgate Rd, Virginia — ~4 km, 10 min.
• First drive on the left: the passenger navigates.

blocks.title: BCF — cooler, ice and sand boards
blocks.detail:
• Buy: a medium cooler (esky), ice bricks, 2 sand toboggans or boards (+ wax), a tyre-pressure gauge if Wongai doesn't supply one.
• No board hire found on Moreton — buy them here.
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 110 for cooler + ice bricks + 2 boards — estimated ≈ USD 72.
blocks.flag: Call BCF Virginia (+61 7 3216 5077) the week before: Friday opening time and sand-board stock. Backup: Anaconda Chermside.

blocks.title: Drive Virginia → JW Marriott Gold Coast, Surfers Paradise
blocks.detail:
• To: 158 Ferny Ave, Surfers Paradise.
• ~80 km via the Gateway Motorway and the M1 (Pacific Motorway).
• 1 hr 12 min from Geebung (Google Maps, checked Nov 2026, weekend traffic) — 1 hr 15 allowed for Friday morning.
blocks.notes: • Possible Gateway toll ~AUD 5–10, billed through the rental — estimated.

blocks.title: Check in — JW Marriott Gold Coast Resort & Spa (room held from Dec 16)
blocks.detail:
• Booked from the night of Thu Dec 16, so the room is ready on arrival.
• Saltwater lagoon stocked with ~300 tropical fish (20 species) — snorkel gear from the recreation centre; freshwater pool with a kids' slide.
• Self-parking AUD 30/day; valet AUD 50/day (verified, Misono/JW site).
blocks.roomType: Deluxe Room, 2 beds (confirm it books for 4)
blocks.notes:
POINTS — PLANNING ASSUMPTION:
• ~84,000 pts/night × 4 = 336,000 (December holiday pricing seen in Nov 2026; rooms.aero's recent lowest is 73,000).
• Marriott.com blocked automated searches — confirm on marriott.com the day Dec 2027 opens.
• No 5th-night-free (4 nights).
• Skipping the Dec 16 night saves ~84k pts, but check-in is 3 PM — early check-in not guaranteed.

CASH: self-parking AUD 30 × 4 days = AUD 120 ≈ USD 78 (in this block's estimate).
blocks.flag: Not booked. Confirm the 2-bed room books on points for 2 adults + 2 children.

blocks.title: Showers, unpack, short rest
blocks.detail:
• Showers and fresh clothes after the flight.
• Keep naps short so the kids sleep tonight; curtains open for daylight.

blocks.title: Walk to Bumbles Café, Budds Beach
blocks.detail:
• From: JW lobby → along the river side streets to River Dr, Budds Beach.
• To: Bumbles Café, 19–21 River Dr — 10 min walk (Google Maps, checked Nov 2026).

blocks.title: Lunch — Bumbles Café (riverside, Budds Beach)
blocks.detail:
• Garden café on the Nerang River, a Gold Coast favourite since 1999.
• Lunch menu from noon; open to 2:30 PM weekdays.
• No kids' section on the current menu — the kids share smaller plates.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU (Oct 2025):
• Queen Bee burger AUD 24 + grilled salmon with Greek salad AUD 28
• Kids (no kids' menu): chicken sandwich & fries AUD 16.50 + prawn sandwich & fries AUD 18.50
• = AUD 87 + 1.9% card surcharge = AUD ~89 ≈ USD 58. Friday — no weekend surcharge (5% Sat–Sun, 15% public holidays).
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.
blocks.flag: Menu is dated Oct 2025 — check the current one closer to the trip.

blocks.title: Walk back to the JW
blocks.detail:
• From: Bumbles → back along River Dr to Ferny Ave.
• To: JW lobby — 10 min.

blocks.title: JW lagoon — snorkel with the fish
blocks.detail:
• Swim and snorkel the saltwater lagoon; sandy beach edges, swim-up grotto and waterfall.
• Gear from the recreation centre (ask about the underwater scooters).
• Hats and sunscreen — UV is extreme even late afternoon.

blocks.title: Drive to Kurrawa Surf Club, Broadbeach
blocks.detail:
• To: Kurrawa Surf Club, Old Burleigh Rd, Broadbeach — 10 min (Google Maps, checked Nov 2026).
• Street/beachfront parking along Old Burleigh Rd (paid).

blocks.title: Dinner — Kurrawa Surf Club (beachfront deck)
blocks.detail:
• Right on Broadbeach with an ocean view — first-night dinner on the sand's edge.
• Dinner from 5:30 PM. Non-members sign in with photo ID.
• Little Nippers kids' meals come with a drink and an activity pack.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU (visitor prices):
• Chicken parmigiana AUD 30 + Humpty Doo barramundi AUD 39
• 2 Little Nippers meals (cheeseburger / battered fish & chips) AUD 16 each
• = AUD 101 ≈ USD 66. Friday — no surcharge listed.
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.
blocks.flag: Book a 5:30 PM table online (kurrawasurf.com.au) — Christmas-holiday Fridays are busy.

blocks.title: Beach walk, then drive back to the JW
blocks.detail: • 10 min on the sand at Kurrawa, then 10 min back to the JW.

days.title: Tallebudgera Creek swim, Burleigh Head headland walk, Burleigh Pavilion lunch; Hurricane’s dinner

blocks.title: Breakfast — Citrique buffet (JW Marriott)
blocks.detail:
• Full buffet: omelette and egg station, Asian and Western hot dishes, waffles, pancakes, fruit, pastries.
• Juice, filtered coffee and tea included; espresso extra.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM LISTED PRICES (EatClub listing for Citrique):
• Adult AUD 55 × 2 + child (5–12) AUD 33 × 2 = AUD 176 ≈ USD 114.
• Continental option AUD 45 per adult.
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.

blocks.title: Swimsuits on, beach bag, load the car
blocks.detail: • Rash guards, hats, sunscreen, kids' masks, towels, water, the cooler with ice bricks.

blocks.title: Drive to Tallebudgera Creek Park
blocks.detail:
• To: Tallebudgera Creek Park, 1527 Gold Coast Hwy, Palm Beach — 31 min (Google Maps, checked Nov 2026).
• Park in the creekside car park off the Gold Coast Hwy or at Tallebudgera Surf Club.

blocks.title: Tallebudgera Creek — calm, clear creek swim
blocks.detail:
• The Gold Coast's best calm water for kids: a wide, sandy, shallow creek mouth under Burleigh headland.
• Lifeguards patrol from Tower 17 on weekends and public holidays, 8 AM – 5 PM, September school holidays to May (City of Gold Coast) — swim between the red and yellow flags.
• Toilets, beach showers, tables and shade in the parkland.
• Calmest on an incoming tide — check the MSQ Gold Coast Seaway table for the day.

blocks.title: Rinse, change into dry clothes
blocks.detail: • Beach showers in the park; bags back in the car.

blocks.title: Oceanview track — Tallebudgera Creek → Burleigh Heads
blocks.detail:
• From: Tallebudgera Creek (Echo Beach end of the track) → around the rocky headland.
• To: southern edge of Burleigh Heads, by Burleigh Pavilion.
• 1.2 km one way, ~30 min, Grade 2 (Queensland Parks); hexagonal basalt columns and ocean views.
• Stay on the track — the boulder fields are a restricted, fenced-off zone.
• No current park alerts (checked Nov 2026).

blocks.title: Lunch — Burleigh Pavilion (beachfront)
blocks.detail:
• Right on Burleigh beach, looking up the coast to Surfers Paradise.
• Full menu from 11 AM on Fridays–Sundays; kids' menu.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU:
• Battered fish & chips AUD 33 + grilled beef burger AUD 30
• Kids' burger AUD 16 + kids' battered fish AUD 16
• = AUD 95 + 1% card surcharge = AUD ~96 ≈ USD 62.
• Saturday — no surcharge (10% Sundays, 15% public holidays).
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.
blocks.flag: Book a 1:00 PM table — Burleigh Pavilion is busy on summer Saturdays.

blocks.title: Burleigh beach and Justins Park
blocks.detail:
• Patrolled beach in front of the Pavilion — swim between the flags only if the kids want another dip.
• Justins Park lawns and shade right behind the beach.

blocks.title: Oceanview track back to Tallebudgera Creek
blocks.detail:
• From: Burleigh Heads (Goodwin Tce end) → back around the headland.
• To: Tallebudgera Creek car park — 1.2 km, ~30 min.
• Alternative: the Rainforest circuit via Tumgun Lookout (Queensland Parks).

blocks.title: Drive back to the JW
blocks.detail: • ~31 min (Google Maps, checked Nov 2026). Back by ~4:10.

blocks.title: Showers, rest
blocks.detail: • Rinse the swim gear and hang it to dry.

blocks.title: Drive to Hurricane’s Grill, Surfers Paradise beachfront
blocks.detail:
• To: Hurricane's Grill & Bar, 1/4-14 The Esplanade — 5 min drive, or a 19-min walk (Google Maps, checked Nov 2026).
• Parking: Soul / Cavill Ave car parks (paid).

blocks.title: Park, walk in — Soul building, The Esplanade
blocks.detail: • Level 1, 4-14 The Esplanade, on the beachfront.

blocks.title: Dinner — Hurricane’s Grill & Bar (ribs, ocean view)
blocks.detail:
• Famous for flame-grilled ribs; views over Surfers Paradise beach.
• Kids' menu (under 12s): pasta, cheeseburger & chips, crumbed chicken & chips.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU:
• Half rack signature pork ribs AUD 56 + grilled chicken burger AUD 29
• 2 kids' meals AUD 17 each
• = AUD 119 ≈ USD 77.
• Saturday — no surcharge (10% Sundays, 15–20% public holidays).
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.
blocks.flag: Book a 6:00 PM table.

days.title: Rainbow Bay & Greenmount — calm north-facing beaches, Point Danger; Misono teppanyaki

blocks.title: Drive to Starbucks Cavill Ave
blocks.detail:
• To: Starbucks Cavill Ave, 2 Cavill Ave (Paradise Centre ground floor) — 6 min (Google Maps, checked Nov 2026).
• Undercover parking off Hanlon St. It's on the way south.

blocks.title: Breakfast — Starbucks Cavill Ave
blocks.detail:
• Open 6 AM – 9 PM daily (verified, starbucks.com.au).
• Coffee, kids' drinks, toasties and pastries.
blocks.notes:
• ~AUD 50 for 2 coffees, 2 kids' drinks and 4 food items — estimated (Starbucks Australia doesn't publish prices) ≈ USD 33.
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.

blocks.title: Drive to Rainbow Bay, Coolangatta
blocks.detail:
• To: Rainbow Bay Beach, 2 Ward St, Coolangatta — 44 min from the JW (Google Maps, checked Nov 2026).
• Street parking along Marine Pde / Ward St fills early on summer Sundays.

blocks.title: Rainbow Bay & Greenmount — swim
blocks.detail:
• One of the Gold Coast's only north-facing beaches — sheltered by Snapper Rocks, usually the calmest surf beach on the coast (Rainbow Bay SLSC).
• Patrolled; swim between the flags.
• Playground, picnic tables, BBQs and bathrooms on the foreshore.

blocks.title: Point Danger lookout walk
blocks.detail:
• From: Rainbow Bay → up the path past Snapper Rocks to the Point Danger headland (Captain Cook Memorial lighthouse).
• To: Point Danger lookout, on the Queensland–NSW border — ~800 m, 15 min uphill each way.
• Look for dolphins and surfers off Snapper Rocks.

blocks.title: Change, dry clothes, sign in at the club
blocks.detail:
• Dress code: dry, covered swimwear only; footwear on (thongs OK).
• Non-members sign in with photo ID showing a residential address — bring a driver's licence.

blocks.title: Lunch — Rainbow Bay Surf Club (ocean deck)
blocks.detail:
• Upstairs deck over Rainbow Bay and Snapper Rocks.
• Lunch 11 AM – 2 PM. Nipper's Meals (up to 12) include a kids' activity pack.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU (June 2026, visitor prices):
• Angus beef burger AUD 26 + grilled barramundi AUD 36
• 2 Nipper's Meals (cheeseburger / fish bites & chips) AUD 12 each
• = AUD 86 ≈ USD 56.
• No Sunday surcharge shown on the menu.
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.
blocks.flag: Kitchen closes at 2 PM — be seated by 1:15. Book on (07) 5536 6390.

blocks.title: Greenmount Beach and the Coolangatta esplanade
blocks.detail:
• From: Rainbow Bay → along the Greenmount Beach path to Coolangatta Beach (~1 km).
• Last swim, then walk back to the car.

blocks.title: Drive back to the JW
blocks.detail: • 44 min (Google Maps, checked Nov 2026). Back by ~4:15.

blocks.title: Showers, pack island bags for Moreton
blocks.detail:
• Island bags: swimwear, rash guards, hats, sunscreen, kids' masks, water shoes, a warm layer.
• Everything else stays packed in the Prado.

blocks.title: Walk to Misono (3rd floor, JW Marriott)
blocks.detail: • In the hotel — lifts to level 3.

blocks.title: Dinner — Misono teppanyaki (JW Marriott)
blocks.detail:
• Teppanyaki show cooking at the grill — a kids' favourite.
• Open Tue–Sun 5:00–8:30 PM.
• Kids' banquets (up to 12) come with miso soup, hibachi vegetables, hibachi chicken rice and an ice block.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU:
• Wadaiko banquet (fillet steak + chicken) AUD 68 + Teriyaki Chicken banquet AUD 58
• 2 kids' Teriyaki Chicken banquets AUD 38 each
• = AUD 202 ≈ USD 131
• Sunday surcharge not published — modeled +10% = AUD ~222 ≈ USD 144.
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.
blocks.flag: Book a 6:00 PM grill table (07 5592 9800) — teppanyaki tables are shared, ask for a family table.

days.title: Gold Coast → groceries → Micat to Moreton Island; first swim, dolphin feeding

blocks.title: Breakfast — Citrique buffet (JW Marriott)
blocks.detail: • Same buffet as Saturday — the quickest option on check-out morning.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM LISTED PRICES (EatClub listing): adults AUD 55 × 2 + kids AUD 33 × 2 = AUD 176 ≈ USD 114.
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.

blocks.title: Pack, check out, load the Prado
blocks.detail: • Island bags on top; cooler empty and ready.

blocks.title: Drive to Woolworths Helensvale
blocks.detail: • To: Woolworths Helensvale, 29 Millaroo Dr (Westfield Helensvale) — 19 min (Google Maps, checked Nov 2026).

blocks.title: Groceries — Woolworths Helensvale
blocks.detail:
• The resort only has a small, pricey convenience shop.
• For 3 nights: breakfasts (cereal, milk, yogurt, bread, eggs, fruit), 2 picnic lunches for the 4WD days, today's ferry picnic, snacks, 20+ L of water, drinks.
• Tue Dec 21 BBQ dinner: sausages/steak, rolls, salad (free resort barbecues).
• Pack the cooler last with ice.
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 230 — estimated ≈ USD 150.
blocks.flag: Confirm Monday opening hours (usually from 7 AM).

blocks.title: Drive to the Micat ferry terminal, Port of Brisbane
blocks.detail:
• To: 14 Howard Smith Dr, Port of Brisbane.
• 48 min (Google Maps, checked Nov 2026) via the M1, Gateway Motorway and Port of Brisbane Motorway; 60 min allowed for weekday traffic.
• Gates open 1 hr before departure (11:30 AM).

blocks.title: Micat check-in — stay in the vehicle
blocks.detail:
• A crew member comes to the car to check you in.
• Bathroom stop at the terminal before boarding.

blocks.title: Micat vehicle ferry — Port of Brisbane → Moreton Island (picnic lunch on board)
blocks.detail:
• Departs 12:30 PM, arrives ~2:00 PM (90 min). Lands on the beach at the Tangalooma Wrecks.
• Picnic lunch from the groceries on the upper deck at ~1 PM; there's also a café and bar on board.
blocks.notes:
• Micat quote seen Nov 2026: AUD 243–284 one way for 1 vehicle + 2 adults + 2 children (stand-in dates); modeled AUD 284
• + 5.15% fuel levy on new bookings = AUD ~299 ≈ USD 194.
• Dec 2026 Monday sailings from Brisbane: 4:30 AM, 8:00 AM, 12:30 PM (demand-based timetable).
blocks.flag: Not booked. Holiday sailings sell out — book as soon as Dec 2027 opens.

blocks.title: Drive off at the Wrecks → resort northern car park
blocks.detail:
• Engage 4WD; lower tyre pressure as Wongai shows you.
• ~5 min south to the Tangalooma Island Resort northern car park (official guests only).
• No driving on the beach in front of the resort — use the bypass.
• Tide: Tangalooma high water 2:21 PM — go slowly on the short beach stretch near the top of the tide.
blocks.notes:
TIDES — official 2027 predictions (Maritime Safety Queensland, Queensland Tide Tables 2027, Brisbane Bar):
• Tangalooma (west beach): high water 23 min earlier, low water 27 min earlier than Brisbane Bar.
• Ocean beaches (east side, Cape Moreton): 1 hr 30 min earlier than Brisbane Bar.
• Queensland Parks: drive beaches around low tide; avoid 2 hrs either side of high tide.

Today (Tangalooma): low 8:03 AM, high 2:21 PM, low 9:06 PM.

blocks.title: Check in — Tangalooma Island Resort, 1-bedroom Family Suite
blocks.detail:
• Reception in the Resort Centre.
• Family Suite: 1 bedroom + large living area + kitchenette; sleeps up to 6; includes wild dolphin feeding.
• Register for tonight's dolphin feeding at The Eco Centre (registration 1–4 PM).
• Free beach towels from Reception (refundable deposit).
blocks.notes:
• AUD 449/night — verified on the resort's booking site for Dec 6–10, 2027 (furthest dates bookable, 2 adults + 2 kids).
• 3 nights × 449 = AUD 1,347 ≈ USD 876.
• Dec 20–23 is Queensland school holidays — expect higher.
• Check-out is strictly 10:00 AM.
• Car parks can be some distance from the room — no porter from the car park.
blocks.flag: Not booked. Bookings open 399 days ahead — Dec 20, 2027 opens ~Nov 16, 2026. Book that day; the 2026 dates sold out.

blocks.title: Unload groceries, settle into the suite
blocks.detail: • Cooler contents into the fridge; swimsuits on.

blocks.title: Swim at the resort beach (Moreton Bay side)
blocks.detail:
• Calm, west-facing bay beach in front of the resort.
• No lifeguards anywhere on the island — stay with the kids in the water.
• Water is ~77°F in December.
blocks.flag: Queensland Parks: no patrolled swimming areas on Moreton Island.

blocks.title: Kookaburra feeding (free)
blocks.detail:
• Daily 4:45 PM outside the Deep Blue Apartments, run by the Eco Centre rangers.
• No booking needed.

blocks.title: Dinner — The Beach Café
blocks.detail:
• Beach BBQ is closed Mondays.
• Open 5:00–9:00 PM for dinner.
• Earlier dinner tonight — the dolphins come in at sunset.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU (Jul 2026):
• Grilled lemon thyme chicken AUD 32 + pepperoni pizza AUD 29
• Kids' fish & chips AUD 16 + chicken tenders & chips AUD 14.50
• = AUD 91.50 ≈ USD 59.
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.

blocks.title: Back to the suite — get ready for the dolphins
blocks.detail:
• Wear clothes that can get wet up to the waist.
• No sunscreen, insect repellent or perfume on hands/legs; remove rings and watches.

blocks.title: Wild dolphin feeding at the jetty
blocks.detail:

days.title: Hamilton Island → Sydney; Whalebridge dinner on the harbour

• To: Bob's Bakery, Front St, overlooking the marina; open 6:30 AM–3 PM.
• Pick up pies, sausage rolls and sandwiches to eat at the airport gate.

blocks.detail:

blocks.title: Maxi Taxi SYD T3 → Sydney Harbour Marriott
blocks.detail:
• From: T3 baggage claim — exit the doors and follow the "Taxi" signs to the rank right outside on the ground floor; tell the rank marshal you need a Maxi Taxi.
• To: Sydney Harbour Marriott main entrance, 30 Pitt St, Circular Quay.
• ~13 km; 25–35 min — Dec 28 is a NSW public holiday, so mid-afternoon traffic is usually light.
• Maxi Taxi for 4 people + 3 checked bags + carry-ons + backpacks.
• Backup: Uber XL from the T3 rideshare pick-up zone.
blocks.flag: The fixed airport fare is an 18-month trial from Nov 2025 — confirm it's still in place.
blocks.notes:
• Fixed fare airport → CBD (The Rocks included): AUD 60 sedan / AUD 80 Maxi Taxi, tolls and airport fees included.
• Modeled AUD 80 ≈ USD 52.

blocks.title: Check in — Sydney Harbour Marriott, Circular Quay (3 nights)
blocks.detail:
• 30 Pitt St — 2 min from the Circular Quay ferry wharves, 5 min from The Rocks.
• Room: 2 double beds (sleeps 4).
blocks.flag: Confirm the 2-double-bed room books on points for 2 adults + 2 children, including New Year’s Eve.
blocks.notes:
• Planning assumption: 66,000 Bonvoy points per night (the rate used in the Sydney & West Coast plan) × 3 = 198,000.
• Marriott points rates include the room tax; no resort or destination fee.
• Not booked — Dec 2027 points dates open ~Jan 2027.

blocks.title: Unpack, showers, rest
blocks.detail: • Feet up before dinner.

blocks.title: Walk to Whalebridge, East Circular Quay
blocks.detail:
• From: Marriott, Pitt St exit → turn left down Pitt St to Alfred St.
• Cross Alfred St to the waterfront and turn right along the Circular Quay promenade, past the ferry wharves and Customs House.
• To: Whalebridge, 8–10 East Circular Quay (Opera House side) — ~500 m, 7–10 min.

blocks.title: Dinner — Whalebridge (waterfront, East Circular Quay)
blocks.detail:
• French bistro on the water, looking at the Opera House and Harbour Bridge.
• Kids menu: burger, fish & chips, crumbed chicken or ham & cheese baguette, all AUD 15.
• Book the bistro (walk-ins only in the bar); ask for an outdoor waterfront table.
• Hours "weather permitting" — check the day before.
blocks.notes:

• 2 kids' mains AUD 15 each (kids menu: https://sundayco.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/14-WLB-Kids-Menu-2026_New-WR1.pdf)
• = AUD 102 ≈ USD 66. Thursday — no public-holiday surcharge.
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.
blocks.flag: Book the bistro for 6:00 PM and ask for an outdoor waterfront table.

blocks.title: Stroll to the Opera House steps
blocks.detail:
• From: Whalebridge → north along East Circular Quay (~250 m, 4 min) to the Opera House forecourt.
• First look at the Opera House and Harbour Bridge; sunset is ~8:05 PM, so it's still light.
• To: back the same way.

blocks.title: Walk back to the Marriott — in the room by 7:45
blocks.detail:
• From: Opera House forecourt → south along East Circular Quay, past the ferry wharves, left up Pitt St.
• To: Marriott, 30 Pitt St — ~800 m, 15 min.

days.title: Manly by ferry — Shelly Beach swim and lunch; New Year's Eve (plan TBD)

blocks.detail:

• Pack for the beach: swimsuits on under clothes, towels, rash guards, sunscreen, hats, kids' snorkel masks, a dry bag.

blocks.title: Breakfast — Starbucks The Rocks
blocks.detail:
• 135 George St, The Rocks.
• Sit-down breakfast: coffee, kids' drinks, croissants / toasties.
blocks.notes:

• ~AUD 50 for 2 coffees, 2 kids' drinks and 4 food items — estimated (Starbucks Australia doesn't publish prices online) = USD ~33.
• Australian prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.

blocks.title: Walk to Circular Quay Wharf 3 — Manly ferry
blocks.detail:
• From: Starbucks → east along Circular Quay West.
• To: Wharf 3 (Manly ferries) — ~250 m, 5 min; 5 min buffer.
• The wharf can change at short notice — check the indicator boards.

blocks.title: Tap on and board — gates close 9:28
blocks.detail:
• Adults: tap on with a contactless credit card (separate cards — one each).
• Kids (ages 4–15): Child/Youth Opal card each.
• Manly ferry gates close 2 min before departure.
blocks.flag: Buy the two Child/Youth Opal cards beforehand at an Opal retailer (newsagents/convenience stores showing the Opal sign around Circular Quay) — the kids can't use a credit card for child fares.

blocks.title: F1 Manly ferry — Circular Quay → Manly
blocks.detail:
• Weekday F1 departures from Wharf 3 run about every 20–30 min mid-morning — aim for the ~9:30 AM sailing; ~22 min to Manly.
• Sit outside on the right (starboard) side for the Opera House, then the Heads.
blocks.notes:
• Dec 2027 timetable not published yet — check the Transport NSW F1 timetable the week before.

FARES (round trip, whole day):
• Fri–Sun daily cap: adults AUD 9.65 each, kids AUD 4.80 each (Opal fares from July 2025, IPART) → ~AUD 28.90 for four ≈ USD 19.

blocks.title: Manly Wharf — off the ferry, bathrooms
blocks.detail:
• Tap off with the same cards.
• Bathrooms in the wharf building.

blocks.title: Walk to Shelly Beach — The Corso → Manly Beach → Marine Parade
blocks.detail:
• From: Manly Wharf → straight down The Corso (pedestrian street) to Manly Beach.
• Turn right along Marine Parade, the flat seaside path past Fairy Bower.
• To: Shelly Beach — ~1.4 km, 25 min at kid pace.

blocks.title: Shelly Beach — swim and snorkel
blocks.detail:
• Small sheltered cove inside the Cabbage Tree Bay Aquatic Reserve — calm, clear water and lots of fish close to shore.
• Bathrooms and rinse showers at the beach.
• Shade under the trees on the grass behind the sand.
• Water ~70°F in December — rash guards help the kids stay in longer.
blocks.flag: Shelly Beach has no lifeguard patrol — keep the kids close. Australian UV is extreme: reapply sunscreen every 2 hrs.

blocks.title: Lunch — The Boathouse Shelly Beach
blocks.detail:
• 1 Marine Parade — right on Shelly Beach, walk in off the sand.
• No reservations; Saturday lunch is busy, so grab a table as soon as you finish swimming.
• Kids' menu (Little Nippers): fish & chips, cheeseburger or pasta.
• Lunch menu served 12–3 PM; open 7 AM – 5 PM Fri–Sun.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT LUNCH MENU:
• Wagyu beef burger AUD 29 + Fish & chips AUD 36
• 2 kids' meals AUD 16 each
• = AUD 97 ≈ USD 63.
• Friday — no weekend surcharge (10% Sat–Sun).
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.
blocks.flag: No reservations — grab a table as soon as you finish swimming. Confirm New Year's Eve trading hours.

blocks.title: Walk back along Marine Parade — Fairy Bower

• To: south end of Manly Beach — ~1 km, 30 min with stops.

• Look for the friendly blue gropers.
